title: Add amount pill to counter in the documentation
description: we already have a counter, it's named "amount pill" but has the same functionality
summary: Documentation task to add amount pill reference to counter component docs.
shortDescription: This documentation task addresses the naming discrepancy between the existing Counter component and its alternate name 'Amount Pill'. Both refer to the same functionality - displaying numeric counts or quantities. Adding this cross-reference helps developers find the component regardless of which term they search for, improving documentation discoverability and reducing confusion about component naming conventions.
